value.summary: This change swaps the default model ladder to GLM 5.2 for both scan and deep tiers, reworks the fallback list, and adds reasoning_effort = "high" with detailed cost/behavior justifications. It is a config-only edit with no code interaction I can see that would break a caller, and the author's own measurement claims cover the provider-compatibility questions I cannot independently verify. Safe to merge from this file's perspective.
